title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 120
paragraphs: When Astyages heard this he rejoiced, and calling Cyrus spoke to him thus: “My son, I wronged you on account of a vision in a dream which has not come to pass, but you are still alive by your own destiny. Now therefore go in peace to the land of the Persians, and I will send men with you to conduct you. And when you arrive there, you shall find a father and mother not after the fashion of Mitradates the herdsman and his wife.”
